title: Rick Explains Quantum Computers Like You're 5! 🤯
caption: Quantum computers? More like quantum *confusion*! #ScienceWithRickAndMorty

scenes.script: Alright, Morty, let’s talk about something way cooler than me—quantum computers!
Uh, Rick? What even is a quantum computer? Is it like a regular one but... with lasers?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Close, Morty! But instead of using 0s and 1s like your dumb phone, they use ‘qubits’—which can be both at the same time. It’s like being both high on candy and not at once.
Wait, so it’s like... a coin that’s heads *and* tails? That sounds impossible!
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty with a dumb looking without understanding.png

scenes.script: Exactly! And because qubits can be linked, or ‘entangled,’ changing one instantly changes the other. It’s like if you and Summer shared a brain and did your homework together without talking.
So, what can these things even do that normal computers can’t?
Well, Morty, they’re great at modeling molecules. Like, imagine figuring out how to make a new medicine without testing every single chemical—boom! Instant breakthrough.
That’s... actually kinda useful? Wait, is this the part where you say ‘but it’s not practical yet’?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png
scenes.web_image: quantum computer in a lab setting

scenes.script: Bingo! These things need to be kept colder than my heart—near absolute zero—to work. And they’re super finicky, so error correction is like fixing a million glitches every second.
scenes.web_image: quantum computer in a cryogenic environment

scenes.script: So, what’s the point if they’re so hard to use?
Well, Morty, some day quantum computers might crack unbreakable codes or revolutionize cryptography. And maybe, just maybe, they’ll help us build a portal gun that actually works!
So... it’s basically a supercomputer for smart people who like cold things?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty with a dumb looking without understanding.png

scenes.script: You’re getting warmer, Morty! And in the future, they’ll do things we can’t even imagine. Now go away—this is my ‘me time’ to invent a quantum beer tap.

topic: Can you explain how quantum computers work?
